note: Interstate mileage open to traffic, calendar year end, as reported by FHWA. This is the authoritative national growth curve for the Interstate System and the only complete year-by-year series that exists for it: there is no published per-route or per-segment opening date for the system as a whole, so a map animation can only show the routes whose completion year is separately documented. The two are shown together in the atlas, with the difference stated, rather than interpolating one from the other.
series: Total mileage open to traffic under the Interstate Construction programme, against the total designated system of the same programme.
scope: Counts the 42,795-mile system designated under 23 U.S.C. 103(e)(1), (2) and (3), including the toll roads folded in at the start and the unsigned Alaska mileage. It excludes Puerto Rico, and it excludes the Interstate-standard mileage added to the network after the construction programme closed — so it is not the same number as the ~46,900 miles that later editions of Highway Statistics report for the signed Interstate system. Mixing the two series would show growth that is really a change of definition.
